h: Shabbos Completes the Refinement of the Omer

p: שִׁבְעָה שָׁבוּעוֹת תִּסְפּוֹר לָךְ (דְּבָרִים טז, ט)
"Seven weeks shall you count for yourself" (Devarim 16:9).
That is: on the night of Pesach
the light was opened to Yisrael,
the revelation of His Godliness, blessed be His Name,
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
from the middah of Keser Elyon,
לְקַבֵּל עָלָיו עוֹל מַלְכוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמוֹ
to accept upon oneself the yoke of His Kingship, blessed be His Name.
And therefore Pesach is called "the day of Shabbos,"
that is, from the side of Hashem Yisbarach.
And afterward they were commanded to count
"from the morrow of the Shabbos" seven weeks,
to be clarified in all the seven middos,
וְהִנֵּה בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ קכ, א)
Now in the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 120a)
it is stated that there are ten crowns of the holy Name,
includes the Name and praise together,
as is written in the Gemara (Pesachim 117a),
it is the greatest of them all, etc.
And afterward it is stated in the holy Zohar:
and this is the Name Havayah in its completeness.
וְזֶה עִיקַּר קַבָּלַת עוֹל מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם
And this is the essence of accepting the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven,
"After the exaltation of the order of praise
and with this one accepts upon himself
the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven,
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כג)
And this is as written (Shemos Rabbah 23:1):
"'Your throne is established from then' (Tehillim 93:2), etc.:
that is, then they crowned Him King at the Sea
שֶׁאָמְרוּ ה׳ יִמְלוֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד (שְׁמוֹת טו, יח)
when they said, "Hashem shall reign forever and ever" (Shemos 15:18),
And why were they commanded here to count
לְהִתְבָּרֵר בְּקַבָּלַת עוֹל מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם בִּשְׁלֵימוּת
to be clarified in the complete acceptance of the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven,
שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹ״ת תְּמִימוֹת תִּהְיֶינָה (וַיִּקְרָא כג, טו)
that through the Shabbosos within the Sefirah
they are clarified in all ten middos.
For "Shabbos" is the letters Shin, Bas;
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
and it is stated in the holy Zohar (II 204a):
the Shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the "bas" is crowned with them.
וּבְרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנז, א)
And in the Ra'aya Mehemna (Zohar III 257a)
it is stated: the Shin is the secret of the three crowns,
and the "bas" is the fourth to them.
That is, on Shabbos one is crowned
with the three first Sefiros and with the three Avos,
And the additional holiness of Shabbos
corresponds to the holiness of Yosef HaTzaddik,
for the Mussaf offering of Shabbos is reckoned as corresponding to him,
as is written in the Zohar Chadash (Parshas Toldos).
being the seventh of the days of the week,
corresponds to the middah of Malchus.
who correspond to Netzach and Hod,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג נג, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (III 53b):
Moshe is the groomsman of the King,
Aharon the groomsman of the Queen.
And likewise in the Midrash (Ru"s, Eikev):
the two Luchos correspond to two groomsmen,
Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh.
That is, Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is the root of Torah she'bichsav,
for he brought the Torah down from Heaven;
and Aharon is the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר הוּא יִהְיֶה לְּךָ לְפֶה (שְׁמוֹת ד, טז)
as it says, "He shall be your mouth" (Shemos 4:16),
and it is written, "For the lips of the Kohen" etc.,
"and they shall seek Torah from his mouth" (Malachi 2:7).
for all agree that the Torah was given on Shabbos
וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי דָּא תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and "the seventh day — this is Torah she'b'al peh"
we call her Torah she'b'al peh."
And this is what we say
in the zemiros of the night of Shabbos Kodesh:
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ פָּרָשָׁה ב)
And as is written (Midrash Rabbah on this parsha, Bamidbar Rabbah 2:6):
the world was desolation and night, etc.,
until they received the Torah," etc.;
that is, after receiving the Torah
that He made them understand the words of Torah;
that is, through the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
that is, the light of His holiness, blessed be His Name,
and the many kinds of food for oneg Shabbos,
and drink of the wine I have mixed"
the bread of the Written Torah
and the wine of the Oral Torah
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רעא, ב)
within the days of the Sefirah
they are clarified in every middah,
in all ten middos within it,
מִשּׁוּם שֶׁשַּׁבָּת כָּלוּל מִכָּל עֶשֶׂר סְפִירוֹת
because Shabbos includes all ten Sefiros,
And especially when there falls on Shabbos
the completion of the counting of the middah of Malchus,
and this is the preparation for Mattan Torah
on the festival of Shavuos, which comes upon us for good.
